# platform-orchestrator_native_agent_runner (Data Source) (RC)

Reads a native Agent registration and its public immutable UUID. Does not enroll, initialize or activate execution.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "platform-orchestrator_native_agent_runner" "example" {
  id = "example-native-agent"
}

output "runner_registration_uuid" {
  value = data.platform-orchestrator_native_agent_runner.example.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Runner ID in the configured organization, using the Core pattern and Native v2 profile of 2–128 characters.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `runner_configuration` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runner_configuration))
- `state_storage_configuration` (Attributes) The state storage configuration for the Runner (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--state_storage_configuration))
- `uuid` (String) Server-issued immutable registration UUID.

<a id="nestedatt--runner_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runner_configuration`

Read-Only:

- `capabilities` (Set of String)
- `key` (String)
- `max_parallel_jobs` (Number)
- `native_execution` (String)
- `supported_protocols` (Set of String)


<a id="nestedatt--state_storage_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `state_storage_configuration`

Optional:

- `kubernetes_configuration` (Attributes) The Kubernetes state storage configuration for the Runner (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--state_storage_configuration--kubernetes_configuration))
- `s3_configuration` (Attributes) The S3 state storage configuration for the Runner (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--state_storage_configuration--s3_configuration))

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) The type of state storage configuration for the Runner
